gtls.source_policy: Freeze main after merging perf/gtls-memory-speed and bumping version to 2.2.1; upload this main snapshot to A100

input.source: Frozen 1460-day inputs from tls2-gtls-delta001-20261114v2; shorter lengths are exact prefixes
input.mixed_generation: Generate on full 1460-day curve per cadence, then take prefixes; 730d/100s matches existing mixed run
input.flux_policy: Keep the frozen y unchanged when varying dy, matching the current performance test; this tests sensitivity of runtime to supplied weights, not calibrated recovery statistics

noise.prefixes: Within each cadence, all shorter baselines are exact prefixes of the 1460-day curve

grid_policy: Each engine builds its own native grid within the complete timed call; record counts and hashes, do not force equal candidate grids

timing.warmup: Small compilation warmup per process plus one full call per engine/input case
timing.scope: Synchronized complete API wall time including native grids, validation, transfers, search, candidate extraction
timing.aggregation: Median of 3; also retain all raw times
timing.parallelism: One engine process on one GPU at a time
timing.progress: Enable native progress where available; report case index and elapsed time

validation: Check finite outputs and injected-period recovery
Compare each engine with its own local output where available; GTLS and CETRA are not required to have identical statistics

profiling.policy: Separate runs excluded from timing; discover installed nsys first

hardware.preferred_gpu: A100 SXM4 40GB, matching previous A100 run

proposed_spend_limits.on_limit: Save completed data, terminate running benchmark if necessary, destroy instance; do not extend without confirmation

lease_policy: Only create after user confirms this protocol; try fresh stable slightly higher-priced offers within cap; download/verify artifacts and destroy after completion or failure
deliverables: Runtime vs cadence and baseline plots
user_confirmation: Only the 30 varying-dy input cases; rent A100 under the proposed limits
